_meta.description: World of Sea Battle port seed data. 41 ports.
_meta.coordinateSource: kptjahir/world-of-sea-battle-map ports.csv (open fan map project). Pixel coordinates on a consistent map image; used for relative distance only, NOT real-world units.
_meta.coordinateSystem: x increases east, y increases south. Map bounds approx x:0-1800, y:0-1450.

categoryCodes.k: Caliphate port - tendered by Trade Union guilds

_meta.categoryConfidence: MEDIUM. 'k' is CONFIRMED (Assab, Al-Khalif, Sharhat match the wiki's Caliphate list exactly). 'p' is CONFIRMED for pirate coves. 'f' vs 'n' is INFERRED: the 8 'f' ports closely match the wiki's 8 Neutral Settlements, but with two discrepancies (wiki lists Puerto Salada as neutral, CSV marks it 'n'; CSV marks St. John 'f', wiki does not list it). Treat category as a display hint, not a rule. Verify in-game.
verifiedInGame: Puerto Salada Bay - tooltip reads 'Neutral settlement' (CSV says n) - DISCREPANCY
St. Jean Bay - tooltip reads 'Neutral settlement' (CSV says f) - consistent with f=neutral
Freebooter Bay - tooltip reads 'Independence declared', pirate cove behaviour (CSV says p) - consistent
Fiji Bay - tooltip reads 'Belongs to: [TIF] Espaniol' (CSV says n) - consistent with n=capturable
Port Bord Radel - tooltip reads 'Belongs to: [DED] Antilia' (CSV says n) - consistent
Los Catuano Bay - tooltip reads 'Belongs to: [TIF] Espaniol' (CSV says n) - consistent
_meta.nameNote: In-game names are often longer than CSV names (e.g. CSV 'Brandport' = in-game 'Brandport Bay'; CSV 'St. John' = in-game 'St. Jean Bay'; CSV 'Santa Maria' = in-game 'Santa Marta'; CSV 'Northside' = in-game 'Northside Cove'; CSV 'Bord Radel' = in-game 'Port Bord Radel'). The displayName field should be corrected in-app as ports are visited.
_meta.editableFields: taxPercent, dockingFee, minShipRate, controllingFaction, portLevel, hasMarket are all per-port and CHANGE OVER TIME (guild capture, patches). They ship as nulls and are filled by users. Never hardcode.

unverifiedDefaults.taxPercent: null until observed. Observed real values: 4 (Freebooter Bay), 8 (Puerto Salada, Port Bord Radel, Los Catuano, Fiji), 12 (St. Jean). Do NOT assume 8 globally.
unverifiedDefaults.dockingFee: null. NEVER directly observed in game. Treat as 0 in calculations until a user enters a value. Must be visibly labelled 'unverified' in UI.
unverifiedDefaults.minShipRate: null. Observed: 'Shallow waters ranks VI-7' on Puerto Salada, Freebooter Bay, Los Catuano, Fiji. Means only rate VI and VII ships may dock AND undock. Roman numeral in game; store as integer 1-7.

zones._note: 15 named maritime zones from the Fandom wiki. Ports have NOT yet been mapped to zones - this is an open task. Zones matter because trade good prices scale with distance from the good's home region.
list: Strait of a Thousand Dead Man

factions._note: Port controlling faction is dynamic (guild warfare) and must be user-editable per port. These are the faction definitions only.
notes: Players may have NO faction (observed in game: 'My faction: No'). Unaligned must be a valid player state.
Reputation exists only with the three military factions. Observed scale example: Espaniol 7, Antilia 5, Kai & Severia 5, all 'neutral'.
Trade Union is neutral toward all except Pirates. Pirates are hostile to all.

Trading at a port whose faction matches your own is reported to give a discount (community sources cite ~25% on materials). UNVERIFIED for the 20 trade goods. Ship as a configurable modifier defaulting to 0.
